errors.evidence: The chart purpose is to illustrate the percentage share of different industries and company sizes among all businesses, not the impact of minimum wage increases. No such context is provided in the figure.
The description does not explicitly mention the small gap in the vertical axis between the industry categories and the company size categories.
The longest bar (Gastgewerbe) is approximately 48%, not 49%.
The bar for 'Nahrungs- und Genussmittel' is closer to 45%, not 46%.
The bar for 'Einzelhandel' is approximately 40%, not 41%.
The shortest bar (Baugewerbe) is approximately 8%, not 9%.
The bar for 'Größere Betriebe (250+)' is closer to 39%, not 37%.
The bar for 'Kleinbetriebe (10-49)' is closer to 32%, not 30%.
The bar for 'Kleinstbetriebe (1-9)' is closer to 20%, not 19%.
The description does not mention that the 23 categories include 19 industries and 4 company size classes, as specified in the atom checklist.
